event: The ascent from Floor 21 takes three days through cleared, empty floors.
At the Floor 23 rest node, Dayo's Steadfast register still holds its new quality.
Solenne tries the word settlement for it, rejects it, and files the problem.
At the Floor 26 rest node, Tomás works through the Floor 21 panel documentation.
He has worked at it every rest pause for three days, announcing nothing.
At the Floor 29 junction he studies the threshold marking for four seconds.
Solenne reads that the Floor 21 papers changed how he reads the marking.
They reach the Section 30 boundary going north a second time.
The terminal shows all six green; no new notices.
Vesper reads both construction signatures: unchanged from the first crossing.
Miriam asks if that is unusual; Vesper has no comparison point.
Dayo signals traveling formation and they cross into Section 31.
Within twenty meters, the six Aspect frequencies in the stone read clearer.
Solenne reads Section 31 as built for the version of them that exists now.
Nadia stops: they've been working.
Solenne feels seven Greyback presences ahead, active rather than watching.
Rounding the bend, they see the Greybacks at a widening sixty meters ahead.
Four work at a wall junction while three hold an outward perimeter.
The center group works the junction surface without breaking the joint.
Vesper runs her Workframe; nobody speaks.
After forty seconds the central Greyback makes a new, shorter sound.
All seven move on up the corridor without looking back.
Tomás goes to the junction and documents what they did.
Three new characters, cut in the same script, like the door inlay technique.
Solenne tracks the Greybacks moving north, continuing, not following.
She files that the Greybacks need a new section of her catalog.
Dayo tightens the formation to combat configuration after the second junction.
A broad Tower-built entity stands in a corridor widening, not a Hollow Warden.
It moves to the chokepoints and holds, making them come to it.
Nadia says it wants them to come to it; Dayo agrees.
Tomás says joint targeting is viable but needs an opening.
Nadia says Pattern Break will make one, on her signal.
Nadia listens for the opening in the entity's Brightspirit frequency.
Dayo calls it, and the fight begins.
Nadia's first Pattern Break opens a joint cluster; Tomás's shot lands.
The entity redistributes its load and tightens its position.
On the second Pattern Break, Dayo hits the base joint with Iron Will timing.
After three minutes forty seconds, the structure loses coherence. No XP.
Vesper reads the remains for two minutes while the party recovers.
At the rest node Vesper says these are built to hold a position, a different function.
Solenne files Vesper's read as their best data on Section 31's design.
At the rest node on Floor 32's approach, Miriam asks what Solenne reads on her.
She has closed her notebook, decided to receive something.
Solenne runs the Conductor on her at full depth and answers.
Warmhearted has run at full necessity since the Calcite Labyrinth.
Over it, Miriam built a clinical layer, thinning since the Proving Gate.
Miriam asks what is under the clinical layer.
The same signal at full depth: she has been one layer further away than needed.
Miriam writes in her notebook's main text, closes it, and thanks her.
At the fourth rest node, alone with the dulcimer, Nadia opens her skill window again.
She accepts Resonant Reading, a Tier II Brightspirit passive.
The note says she was already doing this.
Nadia plays the dulcimer three minutes for herself, then sleeps.
The Floor 32 Repository Node terminal glows at the corridor's end, Composite active.
Solenne runs the Conductor on all six and files it under the work.
